spec_input:
Build a beautiful, modern React frontend application for my bakery called "7th Heaven Bakery".

CRITICAL TECHNICAL REQUIREMENT: This MUST be a complete, runnable React frontend. You MUST generate a valid package.json with React dependencies, a public/index.html as the entry point, and a src/App.js as the main React component. Do not generate backend APIs, only the frontend UI so it can be previewed immediately.

DESIGN & FEATURES:

Theme: Use a warm, inviting aesthetic with soft pastels (creams, light browns, and soft pinks) to represent a premium bakery. Use inline CSS or standard CSS modules.
Hero Section: A welcoming header with the bakery name, a catchy tagline ("Taste the magic in every bite"), and a "View Menu" call-to-action button.
Menu Section: Display a grid of our top categories with placeholder images and prices:
Custom Cakes (Birthdays & Weddings)
Fresh Artisan Breads
Morning Pastries & Croissants
Reviews Section: A carousel or grid showing 3 glowing testimonials from happy customers.
Order/Contact Form: A simple functional UI form at the bottom for users to submit custom cake inquiries (Name, Email, Date Needed, Description).
Please ensure all React components are well-structured and fully implemented.
